scenarios.name: Multi-Worker Case CAS
scenarios.primary_fault: Concurrent incompatible mutations from independent workers
scenarios.secondary_condition: Neither worker observes the other's in-flight mutation before CAS submission
scenarios.authoritative_state: Shared persistent store (RedisStore / CaseRepository) at version V
scenarios.expected_recovery: Exactly one worker succeeds (advancing to V+1); competing worker receives InvalidCaseTransitionError
scenarios.observed_recovery: success_count == 1, conflict_count == 1, durable version == 2, single transition in timeline

scenarios.name: Ambiguous Commit + Client Retry
scenarios.primary_fault: Response lost or client timeout after server durable commit
scenarios.secondary_condition: Client retries identical logical mutation with same Idempotency-Key
scenarios.authoritative_state: IdempotencyService store and CaseRepository durable entity
scenarios.expected_recovery: Original case response replayed without creating second business entity
scenarios.observed_recovery: request_attempts == 2, durable_business_objects == 1, cached response replayed with Idempotency-Replayed header

scenarios.name: Federated Round with Partial Client Failure
scenarios.primary_fault: Client C suffers training exception / drop; Client D submits non-finite (NaN/Inf) weights
scenarios.secondary_condition: Clients A and B submit valid updates with unequal sample sizes
scenarios.authoritative_state: FL Engine aggregation buffer and clean candidate model weights
scenarios.expected_recovery: Client C excluded, Client D quarantined; aggregation reweighted strictly over accepted clients {A, B}
scenarios.observed_recovery: Global aggregate matches independent tensor oracle W_expected = sum(n_i * W_i)/sum(n_i) over {A, B}

scenarios.name: Model Round Publication Atomicity
scenarios.primary_fault: Disk I/O error or metadata crash during save_version after aggregation succeeds
scenarios.secondary_condition: Version N was already published; candidate Version N+1 is being committed
scenarios.expected_recovery: Round fails truthfully; no half-committed version N+1 exposed; Version N remains active champion
scenarios.observed_recovery: Manifest contains only Version N; serving weights match Version N; retry commits Version N+1 cleanly

scenarios.name: Worker Restart with Stale Operation
scenarios.primary_fault: Worker process terminates and restarts, clearing all process-local memory/locks
scenarios.secondary_condition: Worker attempts to replay a mutation based on pre-restart version V1 against store now at V2
scenarios.authoritative_state: Durable persistence store holding version V2
scenarios.expected_recovery: Shared CAS boundary rejects stale V1 mutation; restart does not grant authority to obsolete state
scenarios.observed_recovery: Fresh worker instance raises InvalidCaseTransitionError; version remains V2

scenarios.name: Compound Security / Failure Path
scenarios.primary_fault: Privacy budget exhausted or client training fails while Differential Privacy is active
scenarios.secondary_condition: One participating client drops offline during round with active DP mechanism
scenarios.authoritative_state: PrivacyService budget accountant and ModelEvaluationEngine security gate
scenarios.expected_recovery: System refuses un-noised/plaintext aggregation and fails closed with PrivacyBudgetExceededError
scenarios.observed_recovery: True DP noise is verified on accepted clients; budget exhaustion halts training; zero silent fallback
